external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and provide supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
external_entities.notes: Suppliers are outside the system's control.

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: Corporate category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor hosts the supplier document portal and pushes nightly supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.
external_entities.notes: The vendor is outside the system's control.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.
processes.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: Our service loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes the records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor's platform
data_stores.description: The vendor's platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in our cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database in our cloud account into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: upload compliance paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions.

data_flows.name: push supplier extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: Conflicting statements about encryption in transit: System description says "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." The runbook says "the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is."

data_flows.name: load supplier extract
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the nightly extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write supplier records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes records from the extract into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and its platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: Our cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor's platform holds confidential data because it contains compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source says the platform retains insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket holds confidential data because it receives the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The extract contains supplier records derived from compliance paperwork and staff contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database holds confidential data because it stores the supplier records loaded from the extract.
assumptions.basis: The supplier database receives records from the supplier data extract, which contains supplier information and staff contact details.
